question: Who among the following issued Mahzarnama in 1579?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Akbar.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Akbar** issued a **Declaration or Mahzar.**
 
• **Mahzar means pronouncement, declaration, or an opinion.** It also implies petition.
